derivation: from an unused root (probably meaning to disparage) and H410 (אֵל); contempt of God;

occurrences.text: And Eleazar Aaron’s son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.
